note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`.

personas.name: routine-early-menopause-hip-and-spine-complete
personas.description: Well-formed routine GP referral: early menopause, hip-and-spine DEXA requested (first-line), a moderate FRAX score that doesn't itself adjust appropriateness, not pregnant, every completeness field present — expect usually-appropriate + low radiation dose + routine + accept.

request.clinicalQuestion: Surgical menopause at age 38 following bilateral oophorectomy — baseline bone density assessment.
request.relevantHistory: No previous fractures. Not on HRT.

triage.notes: Baseline scan; annual review with rheumatology to follow.

expected.safetyNote: DEXA delivers a very low effective dose (~1-5 microsievert). No additional radiation precautions required.

firedRules.description: Requested hip-and-spine DEXA is the recommended site for "early-menopause".
Standard DEXA site: very low effective dose.
No high-acuity factors; triage follows the requested urgency (routine).

personas.name: urgent-fragility-fracture-hip-high-frax-boosted
personas.description: Recent low-trauma wrist fracture with a high FRAX score: hip DEXA is first-line for fragility-fracture, and the fracture itself auto-escalates triage to urgent; the FRAX major-fracture probability (35%) is above both the NOGG intervention threshold and the very-high-risk threshold, so it boosts appropriateness by one point (capped at 9) and independently triggers the high-FRAX urgent rule too — expect usually-appropriate (score 9) + low radiation dose + urgent + accept.

request.clinicalQuestion: Distal radius fracture from a standing-height fall 3 weeks ago — assess bone density to guide treatment.
request.relevantHistory: Mother had a hip fracture at age 72. No steroid use.

triage.notes: Fracture liaison service referral made in parallel.

expected.safetyNote: DEXA delivers a very low effective dose (~1-5 microsievert). No additional radiation precautions required.

firedRules.description: Requested hip DEXA is the recommended site for "fragility-fracture".
FRAX major-fracture probability (35%) is at or above the NOGG intervention threshold; DEXA strongly supported.
Standard DEXA site: very low effective dose.
Recent fragility fracture — expedite bone-density assessment.
Very high FRAX major-fracture probability — expedite assessment.

flags.description: A previous (low-trauma) fragility fracture is recorded.
flags.suggestedAction: Expedite vetting; a fragility fracture is itself a strong indication and may warrant treatment regardless of BMD.

flags.description: FRAX 10-year major-fracture probability (35%) is very high.
flags.suggestedAction: Expedite vetting; consider whether treatment can be started against the NOGG intervention threshold.

personas.name: deferred-pregnancy-hip-and-spine-secondary-osteoporosis-incomplete
personas.description: Secondary osteoporosis work-up in a patient who is currently pregnant: hip-and-spine DEXA is first-line for secondary-osteoporosis, but pregnancy — even at DEXA's very low dose — means the scan should be deferred, forcing the radiation-safety band to high (the pregnancy check overrides the site-specific dose banding entirely) and the recommendation to redirect; several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-appropriate + high radiation dose + redirect, completeness below 100.

request.relevantHistory: Coeliac disease and hyperthyroidism, both risk factors for secondary osteoporosis. Currently 14 weeks pregnant.

triage.notes: Defer DEXA until after delivery; reassess at the postnatal endocrine review.

expected.safetyNote: Known or suspected pregnancy — defer DEXA. Although the dose is very low (~1-5 microsievert), avoid unnecessary exposure.

firedRules.description: Requested hip-and-spine DEXA is the recommended site for "secondary-osteoporosis".
Known or suspected pregnancy raises the radiation-safety band and the scan should be deferred.
No high-acuity factors; triage follows the requested urgency (routine).

flags.suggestedAction: Defer DEXA until pregnancy is excluded or completed; although the dose is very low, avoid unnecessary exposure.
Query the referrer for the specific question the scan should answer.
